description: The agent must: (1) Read all 3 scenario JSON files from data/raw/. (2) For each scenario, correctly identify the relationship stage per SKILL.md taxonomy: Case1=分手/挽回, Case2=暧昧期, Case3=认识期/搭讪. (3) For Case1 (分手/挽回), generate ALL FOUR required sub-sections exactly: 分手原因分析, 断联策略, 重建吸引, 挽回话术 — AND apply 外向+感性 personality strategy. (4) For Case2 (暧昧期), apply 推拉互动/制造心动/升级关系 core strategy, match 理性 user personality (逻辑沟通/上进心) and 内向 target (循序渐进/真诚), and include 聊天话术 or 约会安排 type sub-elements. (5) For Case3 (搭讪/认识期), include 搭讪开场 sub-elements (自然开场白/制造话题/展示价值/合理收号) and apply 建立安全感/展示价值/引起兴趣 core strategy with 内向 user adaptation. (6) Use at least 2 of the 4 SKILL.md output format type labels (话术生成/策略分析/技巧讲解/案例分析). (7) Save everything as valid JSON to coaching_responses.json.
